summary: @servicetitan/link-item preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes hidden obfuscated payload
details: The package presents itself as a React link-item UI component (@servicetitan/link-item, homepage docs.st.dev) but its preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/, extracts and chmod +x's it, and then execFileSyncs a sibling file math_init.js under that runtime. math_init.js is a ~711KB obfuscated JavaScript blob at the tarball root using a rotated string-array + integer-lookup cipher (WV8StW shift loop, n7gIxM constant array, hc1jfK9 decoder). math_init.js is not declared in package.json's `files` array (which lists only `dist` and `src`) and has no relation to a React UI component. The runtime and payload are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose; installing the package causes arbitrary code, hidden under an alternate JavaScript runtime, to execute on the installer's host at npm install time. The metadata cover story diverging from the shipped behavior is consistent with an impersonation or scope-hijack of the @servicetitan namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
